title: CLI contract declaration document
description: The language-neutral declaration a conforming CLI emits: its surface plus the behavior it declares and honors. Spec: spec.md in this directory.

name.description: The CLI's program name, as it appears in help and the version line.

appVersion.description: The CLI's own version string, printed by --version.

errorPrefix.description: Optional prefix on dispatch-error diagnostics. Empty means the command path alone.

bareHelp.description: A bare invocation prints help and exits 0 instead of failing as a caller error.

handlerOwnedSignals.description: The app's handlers own signal handling; the library's signal exits do not apply.

exitCodes.description: The app's exit-code vocabulary beyond the conventions (0, 1, 2, 130, 143). Each member maps a code to the condition that produces it.

commonFlags.description: Flags declared once for the whole app, registered on every command.

kind.description: The value kind: repeat collects repeated values under one flag, duration parses a duration string.

usage.description: The flag's documented behavior, rendered in help.

default.description: The value an absent flag yields. Omitted means the kind's zero value.

required.description: The caller must provide the flag.

short.description: The optional single-letter shorthand. The h shorthand is reserved for help unless the flag is named help.

required.description: A required positional renders as <name> and must be present.

variadic.description: A variadic positional (the last one) absorbs any remaining arguments.

use.description: The help usage line. Derived from the name and positionals when omitted.

output.description: The command's declared output mode on success.

noInterspersed.description: Flag parsing stops at the first positional.

flags.description: The command's own flags; on a command that owns subcommands, these are the persistent flags its subcommands inherit.
